requirements.desc: For review impl retry recovery, the phase evidence source must include the active spec.json file in addition to src, so a spec.json acknowledgement change can produce changed evidence without an unrelated src change.
requirements.note: R1: review impl evidence source includes src and active spec.json

requirements.desc: For gate task-impl retry-exhausted recovery, the phase evidence source must include the active spec.json file in addition to src, so a spec.json acknowledgement change can produce changed evidence without an unrelated src change.
requirements.note: R2: gate task-impl evidence source includes src and active spec.json

requirements.desc: For review impl and gate task-impl, issue-log.json must not be part of the phase evidence source, so an issue-log-only append does not satisfy changed evidence for those phases.
requirements.note: R3: R4: issue-log-only changes do not produce changed evidence

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests under specs/279-retry-recovery-evidence/tests/ must cover R1, R2, and R3 through recovery evidence source and eligibility behavior.
requirements.note: R4: spec-local coverage declares all recovery evidence requirements
